calculation.description: At each completed date, compute each asset's three-day return reversal. Activate the signal only when prior-day cross-asset absolute-return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-trading-day 75th percentile. The dispersion threshold and stress state are lagged to avoid look-ahead; inactive assets receive a neutral zero signal. Forward returns begin on the next trading day.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission statistics are computed on informative dates with at least 8 valid instruments and at least 3 distinct signal values. 2020-2022 IC +0.033267 (84 dates), 2023-2024 -0.005919 (67), 2025-2026 +0.037002 (76), 2027-2028 -0.017986 (106). The positive aggregate is regime-sensitive and should receive conservative weight. Five-day IC -0.003545 and ten-day IC -0.010192; signal is intended for short-horizon use only.

signal_artifact.method: deterministic on-disk research script; no future data; all 15 tradable benchmark instruments
